import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] sequence = new long[17];

    static long computeMin(long n, int idx) {
        long quotient = n / sequence[idx];
        n %= sequence[idx];
        if (n == 0) return quotient * idx;
        else return quotient * idx + Math.min(idx + computeMin(sequence[idx] - n, idx - 1), computeMin(n, idx - 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        sequence[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 16; i++) {
            sequence[i] = sequence[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long input_value = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(computeMin(input_value, 16));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
